query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "c!"
        FROM agent_capabilities c
        JOIN agents a ON a.id = c.agent_id
        WHERE c.created_at >= $2
          AND c.created_at <  $3
          AND a.account_id IN (
              SELECT account_id FROM account_memberships WHERE user_id = $1
          )
          AND ( NOT $4::bool OR c.created_by_user_id = $1 )
